policy: A soft lexical mismatch no longer prohibits finite neutral original context. Additional context does not establish a task link, current applicability, requirement claim, execution completion, or workflow state.
old_behavior: Soft topical mismatch excluded these source IDs entirely; exact previous test bytes and failing old expectations are retained.
changed_assertions: Only soft-topic emptiness checks now forbid asserted association/current workflow. Hard task, identifier, version, environment, session, privacy, deletion, history, canonical field, exact span, and budget assertions remain.
qualification_fix: An unrelated experimental same-field reference dedup caused one old complete-field error in the initial red log; that change was removed. The existing whole-field quote test passes unchanged.
limits: Offline transport evidence is not answer-quality evidence.
Earlier development source snapshots and all per-fact replay gains/losses remain separate.
